value.rationale: The natural local-mobility observable for three-colouring Glauber/reconfiguration on cycles receives an exact all-size spectrum, not a sample or a known total. The n-even versus n-odd sharp maximum contrast (n versus n-3, with six versus n(n²-1)/4 attaining colourings), exact total edges, and the period-three frozen obstruction quantify trapping and heterogeneous local move availability. Unlike a routine application of a colouring count, the formula resolves every possible exact degree multiplicity and a natural extremal classification, useful as a reference for constrained recolouring dynamics. It does not assert mixing-time consequences.
